result.topic_en: A short number-theory note stating that if a number is divisible by several others that are pairwise relatively prime, it is also divisible by their product, followed by a sketch of the proof.
result.transcription:
Wenn eine Zahl theilbar ist durch mehrere
andere, welche sämmtlich relativ Primzahlen
sind d. h. jede zu jeder, so ist sie auch
durch das Product theilbar:
$a \mid b, c, d.$
$a = mb$ folglich $m = nc$ folglich
$a = nbc$[?]

methods.what: Divisibility by pairwise coprime divisors implies divisibility by their product
methods.quote:

andere, welche sämmtlich relativ Primzahlen
sind d. h. jede zu jeder, so ist sie auch
durch das Product theilbar

methods.what: Proof sketch: write a as a multiple of b, then deduce the cofactor is divisible by c, so a is a multiple of bc

items.english: If a number is divisible by several others which are all relatively prime, i.e. each to each, then it is also divisible by their product.
